description: The hydrogen hub planned from a projected H2 demand: the offtake grows 10 → 18 → 25 MW over 2027, 2030 and 2035 beside a 40 MW process load on a 200 MW connection. Wind, solar, battery and electrolyser candidates per period. Multi-period; tagged for an Energy Hub study.

study_notes: Each period is the same representative week, with the period's H2 offtake.
Candidates are one row per period (build_year = the period): the plan says what to build when.
After a solve the investment case compares the plan with the hub as it stands today, which buys grey H2 (synthetic demo price and CO2 path) whenever that is cheaper than running its electrolyser.
The connection (200 MW) carries the grid-only site in every period.
